summary: Frontend-only regression for mobile drawer navigation on 胜利28. Verified mobile (390x844) shows compact single-row header with site-logo-mobile + beans chip + mobile-menu-btn and no dark desktop utility bar; clicking mobile-menu-btn opens nav-drawer with all account info, 8 drawer-menu-* items, 4 drawer-utility-* buttons, and drawer-refresh/theme/logout. Clicking drawer-menu-games navigates to /games and auto-closes drawer; current page highlighted with bg-amber-500. drawer-theme toggles html.dark. Drawer closes via overlay click and via X close button. Desktop (1920) still shows original utility-bar/site-logo/main-menu with account-beans/theme-toggle/account-logout and no mobile-menu-btn. No horizontal overflow on / /games /shop pages in mobile.

issues: Radix Dialog a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for {DialogContent}' — add <SheetDescription> or aria-describedby to SheetContent to satisfy accessibility.

action_items: (Optional) Add SheetDescription (or aria-describedby) inside nav-drawer SheetContent to remove Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: AccountBar.jsx is well-structured; consider extracting the desktop and mobile subtrees into their own components to keep the file focused (~200 lines is fine currently).
Radix Dialog requires an accessible description; add <SheetDescription className='sr-only'> under SheetTitle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile drawer nav shipped and fully functional. Only minor a11y warning about missing SheetDescription. mainMenu 'exchange' item routes to /shop (not /exchange) — remember that when testing exchange navigation.
